options.name: Home page ACF repeater (home_reviews_teaser)
cons: Wrong ownership — reviews are global not Home-specific

options.name: ACF Options page shared reviews
cons: No per-review URL/archive without extra work
Large lists less ergonomic than CPT admin
Requires new ACF JSON group + helper

options.name: Reviews CPT
cons: New post type registration + templates + migration
group_fp02_page_reviews already covers page repeater pattern

options.name: Hybrid (shared include + options + static fallback; optional future CPT)
pros: Options as source now; CPT slot later
Aligns with existing group_fp02_page_reviews as optional page override later
cons: Slightly more theme helper code than pure Options

rationale: FP-0002 already has fp02-site-settings options infrastructure and a dedicated reviews page ACF group (unused). Hybrid Options + shared include + static fallback delivers shared reviews without Home admin coupling and without CPT cost. CPT remains a future escalation path if operator needs many individually managed reviews.
